claim: At n=7 and nominal confidence 90%, 95%, or 99%, the binomial-factor Stringer bound pointwise dominates the one-sided Gaffke bound and is therefore distribution-free conservative under independent sampling.

levels.conclusion: For n=7 at this alpha, the binomial Stringer bound pointwise dominates the one-sided Gaffke bound.
